I did not find equally clear public documentation on Erdoğan’s internal party staffing process or cabinet-selection criteria beyond high-level appointments and observable outcomes. This suggests Erdoğan’s system sometimes empowered gatekeepers who could block scrutiny rather than capable accountability officers.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3","7B.10"]},{"title":"Turkey blocks access to Instagram platform but gives no reason","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-08-02","url":"https://theprint.in/world/turkey-blocks-access-to-instagram-platform-but-gives-no-reason/2204688/","summary":"Turkey blocked Instagram nationwide without explanation or duration, and criticism of the ban led to arrest. This is evidence of effective coercive enforcement, but not of meritocratic empowerment.","question_ids":["8B.4","8B.3","7B.10"]},{"title":"Freedom in the World 2024: Turkey","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Freedom House says state media favored the AKP and authorities restricted speech and used state leverage to entrench incumbency.
